source_behavior.on_open: Reset the current command query and open the command dialog.
source_behavior.destination_visibility: Only destinations accepted by the source CanNavigate authorization check are exposed.
source_behavior.activation: RunCommand rechecks authorization immediately before navigation.

context_guards: tenant.view authorization in the context handler
laravel_adaptation.candidate_filter: workspaceRoutes are exposed only when !hidden and resolveCapability(context, route).state === enabled.
laravel_adaptation.activation_recheck: resolveCapability(context, route) is evaluated again at click time and navigation is refused if it is no longer enabled.

runtime_path: Authenticated user enters the Laravel tenant workspace.
TenantBootstrap loads GET /tenants/{tenant}/context through auth + tenant.context.
AppShell receives the authoritative tenant FrontendContext.
Quick Search or Ctrl+K opens CommandPalette and clears stale query text.
CommandPalette derives visible destinations through resolveCapability(context, route).
The user searches only the currently authorized/available destination set.
On selection, resolveCapability is rechecked and the target is built only from context.tenant.slug.
The router navigates only after that recheck succeeds; otherwise the dialog remains open without a fake success path.

authorization.destination_visibility: Fails closed on permission, connector scope, explicit capability, or missing advertised API contract.
authorization.permission_revoked_before_click: Navigation is refused by the activation-time capability recheck.
authorization.anonymous_runtime_semantics: The authoritative tenant context is not returned to an unauthenticated JSON caller.

tenant_isolation.authoritative_context: The context endpoint is tenant-scoped and returns permissions/API URLs for the active tenant only.
tenant_isolation.cross_tenant_idor: There is no direct resource ID in this operation; foreign tenant context access without membership returns 404.
tenant_isolation.caller_url_tenant_resistance: A mismatched URL tenant cannot control command navigation because targets use context.tenant.slug, not the caller path parameter.
tenant_isolation.tested_example: The React acceptance starts at /tenants/beta with authoritative context tenant alpha; successful command navigation resolves to /tenants/alpha/sites.

runtime_semantics.persistence: not applicable; this operation does not mutate server state
runtime_semantics.idempotency: Repeated open/search/close cycles create no server mutation and reset stale query state on each open.
runtime_semantics.retry_safety: Safe for repeated invocation because the operation is navigation/read-only.
runtime_semantics.rollback_or_cancellation: Closing the palette cancels the pending UI interaction; no server state exists to roll back.
runtime_semantics.runtime_audit_event: not applicable to this navigation-only control

proof: The real Quick Search trigger opens the labeled dialog and maintains aria-expanded/aria-controls state.
A destination lacking the authoritative permission/API contract is not disclosed and a truthful empty state is shown.
Capability is rechecked at activation time; revoking permission before click prevents navigation and keeps the dialog open.
Successful navigation uses context.tenant.slug rather than a mismatched caller URL tenant.
Ctrl+K opens the canonical path and each new open clears stale query text.
Exact canonical operation identity and PENDING pre-state are asserted from the generated reconciliation.
GET /tenants/{tenant}/context is verified as a real auth + tenant.context route.
Authoritative active-tenant permissions and tenant-scoped API URLs are returned without leaking another tenant's permission set.
Guest JSON context returns 401, missing tenant.view returns 403, and foreign tenant access without membership returns 404.

canonical_denominator.accounting_note: This is the isolated denominator contribution of exactly this operation; parallel unmerged worker contributions are intentionally not folded in.
